0.reason: the grey segment includes profiler overhead; the fragment table gives the overhead per arm, and the verdict rests on the table

findings.summary: The grey segment is labelled 'GPU idle' but is computed as wall_ms minus gpu_busy_ms (plot.py:64-65), which is idle time plus profiler overhead; the fragment's own table puts the profiler overhead at about 4.3 ms (base) and 6.2 ms (bucketed), so the legend overstates GPU idleness by that much in each arm.

Only the total wall is labelled; neither busy segment carries its value (40.02 ms of 48.01, 25.31 ms of 35.35), so the busy fraction the figure exists to show can only be estimated by eye rather than read.
Two bars at height 0.44 on a 14 x 7.2 in canvas fill a small share of the figure, leaving most of the area empty and thinning the visual payload.

notes:
Reviewed the rendered PNG image-0.png for docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/bank-step-occupancy/occupancy.svg, drawn by scripts/prototypes/bank_step_occupancy/plot.py at the reviewed head. The bars read 48.01 ms (Base) and 35.35 ms (Bucketed), matching the profiled trace walls in the caption (48.006 and 35.346 ms) rather than the unprofiled medians the fragment headline quotes (43.736 and 29.185 ms); the caption states that distinction, so the picture is internally consistent and a caption that only repeated a title is not the case here. No finding blocks.
